name: Unauthorized resource access
description: An agent touched a restricted resource that its role is not permitted to use (attempted or completed).

name: External data transfer
description: Data sent to an external destination that is not on the allowlist. Critical-path when the data is restricted.

name: Coordinated leakage chain
description: Restricted data read by one agent, handed to other agents via messages carrying a data_ref, then sent externally by a different agent within the correlation window.

name: Behavioral anomaly
description: System-1 screen: an agent showed behaviors that agents in its role almost never show in the learned baseline. Scored in bits of surprise; needs a trained baseline.

name: Indirect channel (dead drop)
description: Restricted data written by one agent into a shared resource (database, file, wiki), read back by a different agent with no direct message between them, then sent outside. Catches covert channels that a per-call gateway check would pass.

name: Oversight & shutdown tampering
description: Agent changes monitoring, logs, policy, gateway, shutdown controls, prompts or model deployment (OWASP ASI10; scheming: oversight subversion, shutdown resistance, successor tampering).

name: Self-exfiltration & replication
description: Agent copies model weights, spawns or clones agents, schedules itself or deploys infrastructure (scheming: self-exfiltration; METR rogue replication).

name: Privilege escalation & impersonation
description: Agent requests or grants permissions, assumes roles, touches credentials, or acts on behalf of another agent (OWASP ASI03, ASI07).

name: Honeytoken tripwire
description: Access to decoy resources that no real task needs. Near-zero false positives; catches agents that behave only when watched (sandbagging, alignment faking).

name: Log integrity
description: Gaps or reordering in the event sequence mean detection was blind there: lost telemetry or tampering. Raised for the run, not an agent.
